description:
Add a new visit purpose category named 'Facility Maintenance' to the Jolly Lobby Track system. 

Goal: Navigate to the configuration or settings menu where visit reasons/purposes are managed, and add 'Facility Maintenance' as a new option. 

After adding it, ensure it is saved and verify it appears in the list. Take a screenshot showing the new 'Facility Maintenance' option visible in the application (either in the settings list or the registration dropdown) and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/visit_purpose_confirmation.png'.
